Class RouteAssembly.RouteGroup

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.RouteAssembly.RouteGroup
Enclosing class:
RouteAssembly
@Internal public final class RouteAssembly.RouteGroup extends Object
The settings of a group of handler routes other than its filters, which the routes of the group, and of the groups nested in it, inherit when they are built: a route overrides them.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
